"Trials" is a short story by Jonathan Maberry published digitally on the official site on 1 July 2024. It is also part of the anthology The Voices Within. It is illustrated by Ognjen Sporin. It focuses on Thrall questioning the value of the om'gora trials and reflects on his son's readiness for the trials, his own coming of age, and how to prepare this new generation to build on the legacy he and his friends started long ago.

Tremorsense is an environmental mechanic in the Wormlands and the hollows of Rak-Ush in Azj-Kahet. Moving on soft ground will fill up a bar at a rate of around 5% per second, and jumping or falling while moving instantly grants 20% Tremorsense, as indicated by a visual effect of a puff of dust when landing (jumping in place has no effect). At 90-100%, a Razormouth Devourer will spawn from the ground and attack the player. The Tremorsense amount decays rapidly while standing still or while on solid objects like rocks and roots.

Tuberros is a niffen located in Zaralek Cavern. He was hired by Rannan Korren to be his guide, but the two were captured by the Sundered Flame while exploring Nal ks'kol. They were saved by Perisimona, Scalecommander Emberthal, Ebyssian, and an adventurer. He was also present when the forces of Azeroth fought against Fyrakk and his forces in the Emerald Dream. After Fyrakk's defeat, Tuberros attended the gathering at Amirdrassil when it bloomed on the Dragon Isles. Tuberros later appeared in Dalaran with Algari Expedition and Explorers' League members. He reveals during the quest "Cataloguing" that he is now married to Perisimona.

Turbo Boost was a limited-time event that starts in the x.x.5 patch and lasts for the rest of the season. It reintroduces dinars in the Puzzling Cartel Chip, of which nine are available per character. Trade three with vendors in Dornogal near the Great Vault for a selection of raid items and seasonal dungeon trinkets. Chips come from weekly quests, tasking players with defeating four raid bosses on Normal difficulty or higher, or four Mythic dungeons. Hero track items have no requirements other than the currency cost. Myth track raid items require defeating the item's associated boss encounter on Mythic difficulty. Myth track dungeon items require timing each dungeon with a +12 key or higher
